clips.title: The story
paras: Thunderbrew Distillery serves as the bustling tavern and central gathering place of Kharanos in Dun Morogh. Renowned far and wide for its potent ales, it functions as both an active brewhouse and an essential rest stop for travelers passing through the snowy mountain passes. Inside, patrons find warm hearths, cold pints, and a wide array of class mentors and local tradesfolk.

Perched in the center of Kharanos, the Thunderbrew Distillery is the heart of civic life in southern Dun Morogh. Founded by the Thunderbrew clan—established by Arkilus Thunderbrew and maintained by his kin—the brewhouse is famous across Khaz Modan for producing robust, warming ales built to ward off the biting mountain chill. It operates as the local inn, managed on the floor by Innkeeper Belm, offering weary mountaineers a roaring fire, hearty fare, and beds to escape the blizzards outside.
